Unknown/inbox/WSL1/unknown generation/missing VMP remain blocked. Official references: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/faq ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/reference ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install-manual.
workflow_amendment_v1_33.device_isolation: 02D keeps the full source default profile memory-only. Its source digest is SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes from compact JSON using separators (",", ":"), lexically sorted object keys and ensure_ascii=false, exactly {config: complete source config, devices: complete source devices}; reject NaN/Infinity, invalid Unicode and unsupported/non-JSON values before serialization. Fixed vectors: {"config":{},"devices":{}} -> 079aa36c8373b157f411a389cd569d038a5da42dfcb380ba625a366cc95205c3; {"config":{"user.note":"München"},"devices":{}} -> cc7a06da6878973e8431910042d01f3ff1a8a7bafb972917a3ee329436fddd2c. Equivalent key insertion orders yield identical bytes/hash. Bind source digest, exact sorted used_by and allowlisted identity metadata in GO; never persist raw source config/device values or arbitrary paths. Recheck in memory before every write; any drift blocks with zero writes. Per official Incus instance options (https://linuxcontainers.org/incus/docs/main/reference/instance_options/), these config values are strings only: limits.cpu and limits.memory use Python 3.12 re.fullmatch semantics with patterns `[1-9][0-9]*` and `[1-9][0-9]*(KiB|MiB|GiB)?`; official Python docs: https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/re.html. Fullmatch rejects a trailing newline. Source boot.autostart, when present, is exactly lowercase string true/false. Always set derived boot.autostart to string false whether source is true, false, or absent, preventing daemon restart/autostart. Reject JSON numeric/bool values, coercion and lexical variants. Reject privileged/nesting, raw.lxc, linux.kernel_modules/all linux.*, idmap.*, unknown keys/fields/values before writes. Exact root disk shape: {type: disk, path: /, pool: approved pool} under map key root. Exact bridge NIC shape: {type: nic, name: eth0, network: approved bridge} under approved map key; no optional keys. Reject proxy/host-bind devices and any unknown/unapproved shapes before writes. fixture_base_profile_sha256 hashes canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 ensure_ascii=false JSON with only allowlisted sanitized config/devices. Tests prove repeated deterministic hash, source drift/consumer drift zero writes, true/false/absent autostart all become false, Python 3.12 fullmatch rejects trailing newlines, and no raw profile leakage. Strict-parse source Incus profile JSON with duplicate-key rejection at every depth before canonical hashing; duplicate config/devices or nested keys fail with zero writes.
workflow_amendment_v1_33.local_lxd_endpoint: 02F uses --force-local, fixed identity-mapped client argv[0] paths and a controlled environment that ignores caller endpoint overrides and sets only a validated per-command LXD_SOCKET or INCUS_SOCKET. Query only when the matching LXD or Incus systemd service is already active with unchanged PID and allowlisted executable identity; recheck service and socket unit/listen/canonical endpoint immediately before every query so a listening socket cannot activate an inactive service. Bind the CLI local socket to the matching active service and socket unit; ambiguity blocks without a query. Incus uses the exact LXD subcommands with incus replacing lxc; no duplicate executable prefixes.
workflow_amendment_v1_33.wsl_snapshot_redaction: 02E and the S02 route artifact retain only canonical snapshot digest and allowlisted metadata. Complete firewall and PortProxy snapshots remain memory-only and compare exact canonical bytes at run/JIT checkpoints. No raw/base64 snapshot, PortProxy bytes, ACLs, SIDs or PowerShell output in artifacts/logs. Route capture parses ss output in memory and persists only safe listener tuples/count/digest; no raw rows, PIDs, process names or paths. Tests verify redaction. Firewall and PortProxy are separate subprocesses: PowerShell only receives the 120s/14MiB+2MiB exception; netsh remains 30s/2MiB per stream; both count against combined output, command and wall-clock budgets.
workflow_amendment_v1_33.native_inventory_limits: 02F allows only fixed LXD/Incus units, endpoints, executable identities, packages and fixed client argv[0] paths. Full-project visibility requires root or membership in the matching lxd/incus-admin socket group and is rechecked before queries and artifact creation; restricted Incus project access blocks. lxd_units and incus_units separately contain exact unit rows. Service/socket states use enumerated tuples; known inactive/not-found units are recorded without executable rows, but no CLI query runs unless its matching service is already active. Commands use shell=False, separate validated argv, LC_ALL=C and no inherited caller endpoint variables; each CLI gets exactly one validated local LXD_SOCKET or INCUS_SOCKET. Read profiles, instances, networks, pools, and each pool's storage volumes with bounded list/show calls. Require list/detail agreement and reciprocal profile, network, pool-volume and volume-consumer edges; resolve every typed consumer across the complete project inventory. Unknown volume types, project used_by mismatches or unsupported resource kinds, unresolved/asymmetric references or incomplete visibility block with no artifact. A volume list or detail owner that differs from the project-scoped query is an unsupported inherited/shared-volume case and blocks with no artifact. v1.37 additionally permits omitted or explicit zero MainPID only for the two fixed socket units, normalizes it to 0, and accepts loaded/active/running only for incus.socket coupled to the active stable allowlisted Incus service, exact endpoint and full rechecks; all other unit tuples fail closed. Pool used_by must reciprocally include profile and instance disk-device consumers. test -e/-S status 0/1 means true/false; other statuses fail. Recheck all unit fields, MainPID, executable identity, Listen, socket type and canonical endpoints before each query and artifact creation; drift blocks with no artifact. Total capture <=300 seconds and <=256 commands. Every LXD/Incus response is strict-parsed with duplicate-key rejection at every depth. Command records persist fixed command_id, validated safe_args, exit/byte counts only; raw argv, socket/proc/executable paths, URLs and endpoint addresses remain memory-only. Artifacts/logs assert no raw paths or argv. Config and device values are validation-only. Any limit, schema or duplicate-key failure yields no artifact.
workflow_amendment_v1_33.capture_bounds: S449-02D source-profile and amended S02 inventory reads share limits per capture invocation: <=256 commands, <=300 seconds wall-clock, <=30 seconds per command, stdout/stderr <=2 MiB each per command, aggregate output <=16 MiB, sanitized artifact <=8 MiB, entities <=10,000, including storage-volume list/show queries. Exact inclusive maxima are accepted; each limit+1 or deadline overrun blocks before writes and produces no artifact. Paired boundary regressions use fake clock/subprocess.
workflow_amendment_v1_33.wsl_snapshot_bounds: S02E uses distinct subprocesses: only the complete PowerShell ActiveStore firewall snapshot gets <=120 seconds with stdout <=14 MiB/stderr <=2 MiB; separate netsh portproxy show all remains <=30 seconds and <=2 MiB per stream. Every output byte and command count contributes to shared <=16 MiB aggregate, <=256 commands and <=300s run cap; artifact <=8 MiB. Exact per-command limits accepted; +1/timeout+1 fails. Combined exact aggregate accepted and +1/exhaustion fails before artifact/write. Raw firewall and exact PortProxy bytes remain memory-only.
